per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that pages load within five seconds for routine actions such as loading movie details or navigating between pages.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that initial video buffering does not exceed ten seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide clear messaging and either automatic retry or a fallback stream in case of streaming server failure.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall continue to operate if the streaming server goes down.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that users can browse, redeem pre-paid cards, access purchased titles, and queue purchases for later completion during payment gateway outages.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall continue to operate if the payment gateway goes down.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support around one thousand simultaneous users at peak times.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The server will support a maximum of 1 000 simultaneous users.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall achieve and maintain ninety-nine point five percent availability.
The system shall provide both a dashboard and downloadable reports for administrators to access sales and usage data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All streaming movie sales will be logged in the database and accessible by the administrator.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide a clear privacy notice that is easily accessible on every page and a short summary during signup or payment.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall make its user aware of its information practices before collection data from them via a Privacy Policy accessible on all pages of the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall retain financial records for a duration sufficient to satisfy auditors and local tax rules, and usage analytics for at least several months.
The system shall implement strict access controls for payment data, with additional approvals for sensitive actions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall comply with local privacy laws and data residency requirements.
The system shall provide monitoring and daily usage statistics to detect and alert on performance issues or unusual patterns.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Daily usage statistics should be logged and accessible by the administrator.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that design is simple, familiar, and supports local languages, without sacrificing security or essential flows.
The system shall prioritize paying customers who are mid-playback and critical admin functions during widespread outages.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall continue to operate if the streaming server goes down.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall capture user intent for queued payments without storing sensitive payment data, and process pre-paid card redemptions immediately.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall continue to operate if the payment gateway goes down.'
